entryContract: prepareOfficialImeSessionSource(sourceBuffer, patchBuffer): Buffer; fixed hashes required; no filesystem IO in derivation; no platform execution or recipe mutation

sourceDesign.scope: Only existing GodotIME.$GodotIMEWechat object replaced; complete source prefix/suffix byte-equal, preserving original DOM helper, dispatch, deps, ABI, touch/gamepad and unrelated methods
sourceDesign.release: Allocated IME callback strings freed in finally; native thrown values including undefined preserved; secondary free failure retained in ime.releaseError; sole free failure propagates
sourceDesign.session: Every show creates fresh session and input/confirm/complete/failure closures; current checks object identity, session identity, active and closed before callbacks and after every native callback
sourceDesign.failure: Show and partial listener-registration throws roll back attempted listeners then hide; close invalidates first and attempts each cleanup even after earlier failure; primary thrown value preserved and secondary cleanup first failure latched
sourceDesign.asyncFailure: wx.showKeyboard fail closure throws fixed privacy-safe GODOT_IME_KEYBOARD_SHOW_FAILED Error and retains ime.showError; cleanup also attempted; old-session fail is ignored; no raw SDK payload logged
sourceDesign.cleanup: cleanupFailed boolean preserves primitive or undefined first cleanup failure; show/hide/clear/init cannot claim success after failed cleanup; cleanup-in-progress rejects recursive init before replacement
sourceDesign.normalBehavior: Existing select-all/backspace/reinsert key strategy, confirm fallback, input validation, show option values, and 100ms cooldown retained; no composition/cursor/deletion strategy invented

validation.candidateObject: AST-extracted from real strictly-derived full input source, evaluated in vm
validation.negativeControls: Original pinned object reproduces callback allocation leak, partial-registration stranded active/listeners, same-object late callback delivery and native reentry after clear
validation.parser: Existing pinned Node built-in internal acorn; no new dependency

remaining: No actual native keyboard, browser DOM, C++/WASM, Emscripten emission, final ABI/glue pairing or device execution.
Actual SDK fail-callback exception reporting and native keyboard closure after rollback or cleanup failure remain unverified; throw plus JS-visible latch is not a native failure ABI.
Real registration/unregistration timing and host reentrancy remain platform validation items; model host registration adds listener before invoking optional hook.
Chinese composition, cursor/selection, surrogate deletion, focus and background transitions are unverified; existing replacement strategy is unchanged.
Cleanup failure latches and invalidates stale callbacks but does not prove native keyboard closure or restore failed unregister resources.
Candidate is not registered, applied, built, converted, uploaded, or paired with any current successful recipe or package.
privacy: Tests print test names and aggregate counters only; no actual input, SDK error payload, or native pointers emitted
license: Original complete Godot source notices preserved in derived buffer; no new third-party source dependency
